statement: Bulk evidence that the rs-raft lineage (epic raft-rs-full-cutover and its quests) committed under solve/ (about 103 MB of open-quest evidence, 30 archives, 5 files over 1 MiB, and the 22 files a superseded quest keeps beyond its sealed claim) is relocated to the existing solve-evidence store through the existing evidence owner and removed from the tree, so that the unchanged 20 MiB active-state budget, the closed-quest shape rule and the no-archive rule hold again on this lineage. Every removed file is captured first in an uploaded bundle whose re-download hashed and whose per-file bytes match both the committed relocation inventory and the original blob at the recorded source commit; required proof artifacts and material still consumed by commands, probes, tests, reviews or implementation work stay in the tree; a committed inventory maps every old path to its archived bundle; and future bulk evidence has a documented, tool-supported route through the store so this does not recur. No history is rewritten.

constraints.statement: This quest carries no epic: the landing guard scopes an epic quest to its own directory and the epic files, while this relocation must remove captured files across many quests and touch the evidence owner, one checker and the evidence conventions. Its scope is bounded by this statement and the constraints below, not by an epic authorization; the rs-raft certification epic is not widened.

Change only: tracked content under solve/ (removals of captured files; this quest's own records and inventory; quest-log appends through the solve CLI), the existing evidence owner scripts/solve/evidence-store.js, its command in scripts/solve/commands.js and the CLI dispatch in scripts/solve.js (widened before sealing: the evidence subcommand dispatch lives there, R16 recorded), the new acceptance checker under scripts/checks/, their tests under test/scripts/, and the evidence conventions in docs/development/quest-artifacts.md and docs/development/solver-runbook.md. No src/ change. No change to any budget value, baseline, ratchet, checker threshold or sealed contract; the active-state budget stays 20971520 bytes.

A path may be removed from the tree only after: it is listed in the committed relocation inventory with its sha256, byte size and source commit; it is a member of a bundle uploaded through the existing solve evidence add owner (download and hash verification and no-overwrite behaviour preserved, unique asset basenames); the bundle was independently re-downloaded and every member's bytes hashed equal to the inventory and to the blob at the recorded source commit; and the removal commit records that verification receipt. Files that fail any check stay in the tree.

Never remove: quest.json or log.ndjson of any quest; any path a doneWhen probe requires (required receipts of all quests); any path referenced from src/, scripts/, test/, .github/ or package.json; the current working documents of open quests that implementers and verifiers read now (at least the 2026-10-23 and 2026-10-24 contract, plan, design, dossier, review and vet documents of retained-seed-original-handoff). The superseded quest seed-participant-release-native-startup-census keeps quest.json, log.ndjson and evidence/receipt.json; its 22 other files are bundled and uploaded under this quest before removal, its terminal entry is untouched, and this quest's log carries the relocation record.

This quest commits evidence/relocation-inventory.json (an index with one entry per bundle: bundle, bundleSha256, url, sourceCommit, root, files, shard) and evidence/relocation-inventory/<bundle>.json shards (the same header plus files as [relative path, sha256, bytes] tuples; old path = root + relative path), plus evidence/relocation-verification.json recording per bundle the re-download sha256, extraction, manifest match, unexpected members, member mismatches, the shard sha256 verified and a per-member result string bound to that shard. Every old path therefore maps to {sha256, bytes, sourceCommit, bundle, bundleSha256, url}. All are required proof artifacts read by the acceptance checker and must stay under the 1 MiB file rule. Each affected open quest log carries the owner-appended evidence finding of its bundle; historical documents citing relocated paths stay unchanged.

Bulk evidence is routed through the existing store by an owner-side command (bundle with manifest, upload via the existing add owner, verify, inventory, remove) and a documented threshold in quest-artifacts.md; no second store, no new upload path, no hook bypass. Pre-commit is never skipped in this quest; the landing goes through solve land.

Acceptance is the acceptance checker printing 0 unmet conditions over: solve-active-bytes within budget, solve-files-over-1mb 0, quest-dirs-off-shape 0, inventory complete for every removed path, every bundle verified, required proof artifacts of every quest present for the paths under solve/quests/ and solve/epics/ (309 of the 405 doneWhen-required paths are legacy v1 paths under solve/evidence, solve/oracle and test-output that were already missing at the base and are outside this quest; recorded as a finding for the terminal-proof owner), mapping present; confirmed by test/scripts/closed-quest-shape.test.js and test/scripts/solve-footprint-accounting.test.js green on a lab host and the applicable landing checks.
